summary: Comprehensive testing of FreshMart grocery ecommerce mobile app. Backend APIs: 23/23 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Login, navigation, and core UI features working. Minor issues with product detail navigation and cart persistence verification.

integration_issues.issue: Could not fully verify product card click navigates to product detail page. Clicking on product cards sometimes navigates to search/category pages instead of product detail.
Add to cart buttons are clickable and present, but could not fully verify items persist in cart due to navigation issues during testing. Backend cart API works correctly (verified via pytest).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - minor deprecation warning, not blocking functionality

action_items: Verify product detail page navigation works correctly when clicking product cards from home/category screens
Test complete add-to-cart flow end-to-end: add item → verify cart count updates → check cart page shows items
Address React Native deprecation warning for pointerEvents prop
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Backend: All APIs working correctly with proper auth, validation, and error handling
✅ Backend: MongoDB ObjectId properly excluded from responses
✅ Backend: Environment variables used correctly (no hardcoded values)
✅ Backend: Bcrypt password hashing implemented correctly
✅ Backend: JWT auth with access + refresh tokens working
✅ Backend: Brute force protection implemented (5 attempts, 15 min lockout)
✅ Frontend: Proper React Native components used (View, Text, TouchableOpacity)
✅ Frontend: testID attributes present on interactive elements
✅ Frontend: API calls use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from environment
✅ Frontend: Auth context and cart context properly implemented
✅ Frontend: Mobile-first design with proper spacing and touch targets
✅ Frontend: KeyboardAvoidingView used for keyboard handling
seed_data_creation: No additional seed data created. Backend already has seed data: 10 categories, 22 products, 2 coupons, 1 admin user
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend APIs are fully functional and tested. Frontend UI renders correctly with all tabs working. The main areas that need manual verification are: (1) product detail page navigation from product cards, (2) complete cart flow including persistence. These issues are minor and may be due to test automation timing/selector issues rather than actual bugs. The app appears functional based on screenshots and partial interactions.
